title: Determine the Volume of Rectangular Prisms
focus: Find volume with fractional side lengths

items.stem: What is the formula to find the volume of a rectangular prism?
A rectangular prism has side lengths of 3 1/2 units, 2 units, and 4 1/4 units. What is the volume of the prism in cubic units?
Select ALL statements that are true about the volume of rectangular prisms:
choices: The volume is measured in cubic units.
Volume can be found by multiplying the area of the base by the height.
Volume is always less than the surface area.
Fractional side lengths can be used to calculate volume.

items.stem: A rectangular prism has a length of 2 1/2 units, a width of 3 units, and a height of 4 2/3 units. Calculate the volume of the prism. Show or explain your work.
